[LEXP.3.8.2] **A tie goes to the first operand.** When the scalar `min(a, b)`
or `max(a, b)` compares its operands equal, the engine must return `a`, kind and
sign included: `max(2, 2.0)` is `2` (Int), `min(2.0, 2)` is `2.0` (Float), and
`min(0.0, -0.0)` is `0.0`. Two `Int` operands compare exactly; an `Int` beside a
`Float` compares as it does in a comparison, promoted to `Float` first
([LEXP.7.3]). A compile-time fold of the same call gives the same value
([LDET.3.3a.8]).
